sections.text:
Yesterday, I worked on fixing an IA bug, but I didn't finish it. I also had a one-on-one meeting with Jackie.
Maggie reported a PTS data issue. I checked it and confirmed that it was expected behavior under the existing logic and wasn't related to our changes, so no fix was needed.
For the other data issue, I need database access to investigate it. I also couldn't run the service locally for debugging without Key Vault access, so I submitted a ticket yesterday to request that access. Once the support team grants me access, I'll continue debugging the issue and update the team in Teams promptly.
Today, I plan to finish fixing the IA bugs. If I have time, I'll also take a look at Advance it!.
I confirmed that the issue doesn't affect QA testing or deployment.

sections.text:
**Q: Does this issue affect QA testing or deployment?**

这个问题会影响 QA 测试或发布吗？

**A: I confirmed that it doesn't affect QA testing or deployment.**

我已确认它不会影响 QA 测试或发布。

**Q: When will you update the team?**

你什么时候向团队同步进展？

**A: Once the support team replies, I'll update the team in Teams.**

支持团队回复后，我会在 Teams 中向团队同步进展。

**补充句型（课堂练习，尚未确认是实际安排）：**

If there's still no reply by tomorrow's stand-up, I'll bring it up again then.

如果到明天站会仍然没有回复，我会在会上再提一下。

sections.heading: 重点词汇

rows: debug locally：在自己的电脑或本地开发环境中调试
The support team grants me access：支持团队授予我权限；本句把 team 作为单数整体，使用 grants
update the team promptly：及时向团队同步进展
The service isn't working properly：服务运行不正常；它不表示“及时”
I confirmed that it doesn't affect testing：我已确认它不影响测试
涉及、使担忧；也可作名词表示担忧
本次要表达“确认”，应使用 confirm
It was expected behavior, so no fix was needed.
I submitted a ticket to request Key Vault access.

sections.text:
词语 含义 本次场景中的用法
locally 在本地；副词 debug locally：在自己的电脑或本地开发环境中调试
grant / grants 授予、批准给予 The support team grants me access：支持团队授予我权限；本句把 team 作为单数整体，使用 grants
promptly 及时地、迅速地 update the team promptly：及时向团队同步进展
properly 正确地、妥当地 The service isn't working properly：服务运行不正常；它不表示“及时”
confirm / confirmed 确认 I confirmed that it doesn't affect testing：我已确认它不影响测试
concern 涉及、使担忧；也可作名词表示担忧 本次要表达“确认”，应使用 confirm
expected behavior 符合预期的行为 It was expected behavior, so no fix was needed.
request access 申请访问权限 I submitted a ticket to request Key Vault access.

sections.heading: 本次重点纠正

rows: 时间应是 yesterday，已发生的动作使用过去式
I also had a one-on-one meeting…
补主语 I；固定表达是 one-on-one
It wasn't a bug. / It was expected behavior.
bug 是名词；这里用 be 动词
I check it and confirm…（描述已完成的检查）
过去完成的动作使用过去式
被动结构使用过去分词 needed
submit 是提交，过去式为 submitted；summit 是另一个词
这里指 Key Vault 权限；语音转写可能把专有名词识别错
Once support granted access, I will…
once 引导将来的时间条件时，从句通常使用一般现在时；这里是 grants，不是 granted
update the team properly（想表达及时）
promptly 表示及时，properly 表示妥当
单数 reply 搭配 there is；也可说 if there are no replies
一般现在时否定使用 doesn't + 动词原形

it's not affect… it doesn't affect… 一般现在时否定使用 doesn't + 动词原形

sections.heading: 重点修正

rows: 已完成的工作用过去时；on 后接动词的 -ing 形式。
some 后的可数名词通常用复数。
confirmed 表示检查后已确认；从句需要完整谓语。
在这里表示系统符合设计。若只是描述原有逻辑而未确认符合设计，则说 existing behavior。

sections.text:

work on fix worked on fixing 已完成的工作用过去时；on 后接动词的 -ing 形式。
some legacy bug / issue some legacy bugs / issues some 后的可数名词通常用复数。
confirm it working confirmed that it is working confirmed 表示检查后已确认；从句需要完整谓语。
original logic working as designed 在这里表示系统符合设计。若只是描述原有逻辑而未确认符合设计，则说 existing behavior。
no fix is need no fix is needed 此处需要 needed。
one-one meeting one-on-one meeting 固定表达：一对一会议。

sections.text:
**Q: Does that impact today's deployment, or just PT testing?**

中文：这会影响今天的部署，还是只影响 PT 测试？

**A:** It might affect the PT deployment as well, because the release depends on completing the PT configuration testing.

中文：也可能影响 PT 部署，因为发布依赖于 PT 配置测试的完成。

**Q: When will you update the team?**

中文：你什么时候给团队更新进展？

**A:** I'll follow up on the ticket after the stand-up and update the team in the Teams chat once IT replies.

中文：我会在站会后跟进工单，收到 IT 回复后在 Teams 群聊中同步。

**Q: What will you do if IT doesn't reply today?**

中文：如果 IT 今天没有回复，你会怎么做？

**A:** If there's still no reply by tomorrow's stand-up, I'll bring it up again then.

中文：如果到明天站会时仍没有回复，我会在会上再提一下。
